words: Every Sunday morning I do the big cook-up – a roast, a pot of stew and whatever's left in the fridge – before the week runs away on me. Altogether I've 7850 US cents to spend - that's the whole lot, so not a cent more than that across the lot of it. Four kids, two dogs and a husband who eats like a hay-baler means the pepper vanishes faster than weeds in May. Every item on the list should be there ready for me - none of them missing, because I can't be doing with chasing half an order. Here's my list - 1 x protein powders where the flavor is banana, and 3 x pepper where the pack type is large serve. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not. I'd sooner buy the large serve pack once than be caught short halfway through a recipe – that's a job I'm not doing again. Ask me whatever you like to narrow it down – I'm grand for a chat while the kettle's on.
